items.title: 18.4 Wave nature of particles (zarrat ki lehar jaisi fitrat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the wave nature of particles with Example 18.3 (PDF 125-127, printed 121-123).

blocks.text: Hum dekh chuke hain ke roshni ki dual nature (dohri fitrat) hai: kabhi wave ki tarah aur kabhi particle ki tarah kaam karti hai. Nature (qudrat) mein symmetry (barabari) maan kar French physicist Louis de Broglie ne 1924 mein kaha ke particles mein bhi wave jaisi properties (khasiyatein) honi chahiye. Photon ka momentum p yeh hai:
de Broglie ne kaha ke mass m aur velocity v wale material (maddi) particle ka momentum bhi isi formula se diya jaye. Yani:

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Eq. 18.10 ko λ = h/ρ chhapti hai. Yahan ρ (rho) ghalti se chhapa hai; sahi p (momentum) hai: λ = h/p = h/mv.

Yahan λ particle se judi wave ki wavelength hai (ise de Broglie wavelength kehte hain). Is tarah electron ko particle bhi samjha ja sakta hai aur wave bhi. Equation 18.10 ko de Broglie relation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab de Broglie relation ko 'Equation 18.9' likhti hai; sahi Equation 18.10 hai (18.9 pair production wali equation hai).

Bare mass aur aam speed wali cheez ki wavelength itni chhoti hoti hai ke us ke wave effects (asraat), jaise interference aur diffraction, nazar hi nahi aate. Maslan 20 g ki rifle ki goli 330 m s⁻¹ se ud rahi ho to us ki wavelength:
Yeh wavelength itni chhoti hai ke kisi bhi tareeqe se napi ya mehsoos nahi ki ja sakti.
Doosri taraf 1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹ se chalte electron ke liye:
Yeh wavelength X-rays ki range mein hai. Is liye electrons ke diffraction effects nape ja sakte hain, jab ke goliyon ke interference effects nahi.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Wajah: λ = h/mv. Mass bohat chhota (electron) ho to λ itni bari hoti hai ke atoms ke darmiyan faaslon jitni ho jati hai, aur crystal us ke liye grating ka kaam karta hai. Goli ka mass bohat zyada hai, is liye λ itni chhoti hai ke napi hi nahi ja sakti.

blocks.title: Example 18.3
blocks.problem: Positron-electron pair ke annihilation se do photons bante hain. Electron aur positron har aik ki rest mass energy 0.51 MeV hai, is liye har photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai. In photons ki wavelength nikalein.
steps: E = hf = hc/λ, is liye λ = hc/E

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab sawal mein 'The rest mass energy of each photon is 0.51 MeV' likhti hai. Photon ka rest mass hota hi nahi; 0.51 MeV electron (ya positron) ki rest mass energy (m₀c²) hai. Annihilation mein yahi energy har photon ko milti hai, is liye har photon ki energy 0.51 MeV hai aur jawab 2.43 pm sahi hai.
Davisson aur Germer ka experiment

Electrons ki wave nature ka pakka proof (saboot) Clinton J. Davisson aur Lester H. Germer ne diya. Unhon ne dikhaya ke electrons metal crystals se bilkul X-rays (ya kisi aur wave) ki tarah diffract hote hain. Un ka apparatus Fig. 18.7 mein hai: garam filament se nikle electrons ko ek adjustable (badla ja sakne wale) voltage se accelerate (tez) kiya jata hai aur yeh beam nickel crystal par dali jati hai. Metal ki surface (satah) se scattered (bikhre) electrons regular peaks (chotiyon) mein nikle. Unhon ne in peaks ko diffraction ka result samjha, bilkul NaCl crystal se X-rays ke diffraction ki tarah. Electrons ki waves ki wavelength bilkul utni hi nikli jitni de Broglie ne batayi thi.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Germer ka naam 'Laster H. Germer' chhapti hai; sahi naam Lester H. Germer hai. Kitab de Broglie ko yahan 'de Brogalie' bhi likhti hai.

blocks.alt: Garam filament wali electron gun apni beam neeche nickel crystal par dalti hai. Crystal se dashed line mude hue scale par sarakne wale detector tak jati hai; incident aur scattered beam ke darmiyan angle phi hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 18.7: electron diffraction ke liye Davisson aur Germer ka experimental arrangement (kitab ki Figure 18.7 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Detector ko scale par ghuma kar har angle φ par scattered electrons ka current napa jata hai. Kuch khaas angles par current ke peaks (chotiyan) milte hain, bilkul X-rays ke diffraction ki tarah; yeh electrons ki wave nature ka proof hai.

Energy Ve wali electron beam nickel crystal par parti hai. Crystal ki surface se diffract hui beam detector mein jati hai aur current I ki shakal mein record hoti hai. Electron gun mein potential V se accelerate (tez) hone par electron ki K.E. mein increase (izafa):

blocks.text: Ek experiment mein accelerating voltage V = 54 volts tha, is liye:
Crystal ki surface se diffract hui electrons ki beam 65° ke glancing angle par mili. Bragg's equation ke mutabiq:

blocks.text_alt: Thus 2 × 0.91 × 10⁻¹⁰ m × sin 65° = λ, which gives

blocks.text: Yani experiment (Bragg) se napi gayi wavelength (1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) theory (de Broglie) se nikali gayi wavelength (1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m) se taqreeban bilkul mil gayi.

blocks.title: Hisaab check karein
blocks.text: In values se poora hisaab: 2 × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ × 54 × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ = 1.57 × 10⁻⁴⁷, is ka square root 3.97 × 10⁻²⁴, aur λ = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ ÷ 3.97 × 10⁻²⁴ = 1.67 × 10⁻¹⁰ m. Kitab 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m likhti hai; yeh rounding (gol karne) ka chhota sa farq hai. Natija wahi hai: theory aur experiment taqreeban barabar hain.
Protons, neutrons, hydrogen atoms aur helium atoms se bhi diffraction patterns dekhe gaye hain. Yeh particles ki wave nature ka mazboot proof hai.

Particles ki dual nature par kaam ke liye Prince Louis Victor de Broglie ko 1929 mein physics ka Nobel Prize mila. Clinton Joseph Davisson aur George Paget Thomson ne particles ki wave nature ki experimental confirmation (tajurbe se tasdeeq) par 1937 ka Nobel Prize mil kar liya.

blocks.prompt: 100 V se tez kiye gaye electron ki de Broglie wavelength nikalein.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: de Broglie: λ = h/p = h/mv (18.10); tez kiye electron ke liye λ = h/√(2mVe) (18.11).
Goli ki wavelength bohat chhoti (1 × 10⁻³⁴ m); electron ki X-rays jitni (7 × 10⁻¹⁰ m).
Annihilation ke photons (0.51 MeV): λ = 2.43 pm (Example 18.3).
Davisson-Germer: nickel crystal se electron diffraction; 54 V par λ ≈ 1.66 × 10⁻¹⁰ m, Bragg se 1.65 × 10⁻¹⁰ m.
